featurePreservation: All existing create-project and billing fields, cadence options, per-worker conditions, roles, financial lifecycles and explicit issue/send actions retained. No migrations or business-rule changes.

improvements.improvement: The New Project workflow button now exposes its active step and a ready-to-create state while retaining the existing single CTA.
The owner/finance project register shows a live result count plus the active status and search context beside its controls.
No-match states explain that filters caused the empty result and offer a one-click reset.
Project managers can filter their authorized project list by client, with the selected client shown in the live filter context and reset path.
Project-manager mobile project cards keep Work and Team actions directly reachable inside each project summary card instead of hiding them behind the desktop table.
Owner/finance register rows expose direct Work and Team shortcuts, with the Invoices shortcut gated to finance-capable users.
Owner project metadata is visually separated into status, currency, timezone and date groups for faster scanning.
The create form provides five anchored steps, and clicking an optional step opens its disclosure before scrolling to it.
The first run shows only client, name, cost center, currency, timezone and dates; optional context, people, commercial and planning fields are behind clear disclosures.
A persistent Required/Optional legend explains when each field group is expected.
Timezone and project dates sit with the essential identity fields, so users do not need optional settings to schedule a project.
Selecting a client explains which defaults are inherited and how project currency affects budgets, rates and expense limits.
Description, project alias, project manager and every on-site/contact field are grouped behind a Project context disclosure with a concise preview.
Validation failures automatically open optional settings or people disclosures and focus the first invalid control.
A responsive save bar keeps the action clear: sticky on desktop, naturally positioned above the page end on phones, with truthful Saving feedback.
Create validation summaries show a localized review message, error count and links to assignment date targets.
People, project defaults, billing frequency and individual worker rates/pay/expense terms are grouped behind an optional People disclosure with a concise preview.
Billing model, expected hours and client minimum hours are grouped behind an optional Commercial defaults disclosure, with the selected currency previewed in its summary.
The form explicitly reassures users that entered values stay in place when validation needs correction, and the submit state resets after a failed response.
Project detail KPI cards use a two-column mobile grid to reduce the vertical climb before the operational tabs.
Detail tabs become horizontally scrollable on narrow screens and announce the current section above the tab strip.
Commercially authorized users can open the client from the detail header and Overview facts, while project managers see the client name without an unauthorized link.
Configured site contacts expose a direct Open client contacts affordance for authorized roles.
The project detail header provides task verbs for Log time, Record expense, Create work report and invoice preparation/viewing, with Team still one click away.
Project detail empty states now point to the next useful operation: add expense, assign a worker, open planning/reports or open billing.
The record composer keeps its selected project in the stream options and filters rules to that project.
The whole-period wizard limits the billing-stream choice to the selected project.
Stream options show project number/name context instead of an opaque rule identifier.
Cadence values use readable localized labels for manual, weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly, custom, and milestone streams.
The record stream selector includes a visible effective-date interval for each stream.
Effective-date guidance sits directly under the selected stream control.
Record-based and whole-period creation are mutually exclusive choices that preserve the selected stream and dates and honor pending-operation locks.
Each creation mode explains when to select records versus use a configured period or milestone.
Direct mode=whole-period links open the whole-period surface while retaining the selected rule and dates.
The record composer identifies the current project and offers a direct project-billing review link.
Projects without supported streams show scoped setup, work, expense, and record-review actions.
Empty inventories collapse secondary record filters after loading while preserving a reopenable Filters disclosure.
The composer explicitly says that the end date is inclusive and cadence alignment occurs before loading.
Current and previous billing-period shortcuts align dates with the selected stream cadence and project timezone.
Each active stream has a contextual Create invoice action that opens its matching rule.
Each active stream exposes a secondary whole-period or milestone action without removing record billing.
The stream register explains where eligibility blockers appear before a draft is created.
Stream rows show project name beneath the project number when available.
Stream project context links to the authorized project billing detail route.
The stream register header and empty state both provide a prominent New billing stream action.
New billing stream setup appears before reference directories so the primary task is reachable first.
Setup action buttons focus the form for the chosen action, including stream, issuer, tax, and numbering forms.
New stream fields are grouped into Project/service, Schedule, Issuer/tax, and Delivery fieldsets without changing names or options.
The no-tax-profile warning spans the setup form width and keeps its tax-profile remedy link.
Mobile invoice cards keep invoice, project, and ready-PDF actions together beside clearly labeled service and payment dates.
Adds a one-tap Review invoice register jump beside the ledger heading.
Reports the visible and scoped authorized ledger row counts in a live status line.
Shows active filters as removable, URL-preserving chips with a clear-all action.
Progressively discloses client, project, currency and aging filters while keeping search/status primary.
Makes filter reset return to the full register and preserve an explicit language query.
Separates invoice identity from client identity in mobile cards and gives the card action a specific invoice label.
Turns authorized client names into focused client-directory links from ledger rows.
Turns authorized project names into focused project detail links from ledger rows.
Adds semantic invoice, client and project link labels that include the human-readable identity.
Gives every aging bucket link a spoken bucket and exact formatted amount label.
Provides a useful no-match recovery state with full-register and billing-record paths.
Keeps aging quick links scoped to the current client/project/search filters and explicit locale.
Keeps four accounting status summaries in a compact two-column phone/tablet grid so the register empty state is visible sooner.
Adds explicit status button labels and selected-state focus treatment for pack summaries.
Adds a compact register count and active-state summary beneath the status controls.
Adds a direct View pack register jump beside the accounting context heading.
Adds source-readiness guidance to the empty accounting register.
Gives auditors a read-only source ledger path and keeps pack generation out of their empty state.
Gives authorized finance/owner users a Generate a period pack path while retaining the ledger review path.
Keeps credential failures inline, field-local and out of the generic recovery dialog.
Preserves the entered email and focuses the password correction after a recoverable credential failure.
Adds an explicit retry sign-in action for non-credential errors without bypassing rate limits.
Keeps a readable Sections label on the section navigator trigger at phone widths.
Exposes the current section in the trigger name/title while keeping the visual context compact.
Adds a live result count to section search and restores trigger focus when the dialog closes.
Finance project selector appears before attention cards and financial totals.
Selected project name opens its project workspace.
Prepare an invoice opens invoice creation directly for the selected project, including milestone billing.
Team and billing conditions are reachable beside the selected project.
Invoices shortcut opens the register already scoped to the selected project.
Collections shortcut opens selected-project receivables.
Cash calendar and recent-period explanation form a compact utility row instead of separate large panels.
Approved unbilled WIP is clickable and opens invoice preparation for writers, invoice review for auditors.
Revenue candidate is clickable and opens its source records.
Zero settlement and reimbursement counts no longer receive warning emphasis.
Finance source and project workflow links preserve the selected interface language.
Phone workspace search occupies its own full-width row rather than being compressed by Print.
Workspace search includes a one-click clear control that returns focus to the input.
Search supports Arrow Up to the final suggestion plus Home/End navigation through suggestions.
Escape closes search suggestions without throwing keyboard focus out of the search field.
Search suggestions remain mounted while keyboard focus moves from the input into results.
The J&A breadcrumb links directly to workspace home.
Filtered time entries display a clickable project identity instead of requiring sidebar navigation.
Time entries link directly to the same project’s expenses.
Time entries link directly to the same project’s work reports.
Expenses link directly to time entries for the selected project.
Expenses link directly to work reports for the selected project.
Work reports provide contextual return links to the selected project’s time and expenses.
